title: Joint metric, spectrum and heat-trace limit for FK–Ising maps
exact_target: For critical spherical FK–Ising maps with the manuscript graph and stationary-measure conventions, does $(M_n,a_n$ $d_n,\mu _n)$, the complete ordered spectrum (n $\lambda _n,j)_{j\geq 0}$, and the heat trace converge jointly to the sqrt(3)-quantum sphere, its closed Liouville Dirichlet-form spectrum, and its heat trace? Require compact resolvent, constants as the one-dimensional kernel, and locally uniform heat-trace convergence for every positive-time interval.
